div.div: A FAST, RETRO-THEMED RHYTHM ARCADE GAME

div.p: BeatTapper is a responsive rhythm game featuring four-lane gameplay. Hit falling notes in sync with the beat using keys A S D F.
UI and theme inspired by WIN95 — clean playfield, dynamic hold notes, and a combo + judgement scoring system. Optimized for smooth animation and precise input feedback.

ol.li: Open the Play link in the About section of this repo.
Wait for the game to begin — no install needed.
Press the correct key when a note crosses the hit line.
Hold A/S/D/F for sustained hold notes until complete.
Score points for timing accuracy. Keep that combo alive.

div.p: Notes fall vertically. The hit line is the timing window for judgement.

ul.li: Submit bug fixes or gameplay improvements via PR.
Add new beatmaps, audio, or visual effects.
Enhance UI — score metrics, level select, multidevice support.

body.div: Built with HTML5 Canvas, vanilla JS, and a passion for rhythm games.
